499

}
502
@keyframes ffFloat{
503
0% { opacity:0; transform:translate(0,0) scale(0.6); }
504
15% { opacity:1; transform:translate(calc(var(--dx)*.2), calc(var(--dy)*.1)) scale(1.1); }
505
35% { opacity:0.2; transform:translate(calc(var(--dx)*.5), calc(var(--dy)*.4)) scale(0.8); }
506
55% { opacity:1; transform:translate(calc(var(--dx)*.7), calc(var(--dy)*.6)) scale(1.2); }
507
75% { opacity:0.3; transform:translate(calc(var(--dx)*.9), calc(var(--dy)*.8)) scale(0.7); }
508
90% { opacity:0.9; transform:translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) scale(1.0); }
509
100% { opacity:0; transform:translate(var(--dx), var(--dy)) scale(0.5); }
510
}

<!-- DRAGGABLE DISCO BALL -->

<div id="drag-disco" style="position:fixed; bottom:220px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:20; pointer-events:auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center;">
999
<!-- Canvas ball -->
1000
<canvas id="discoCanvas" width="110" height="110" style="display:block; margin-top:-1px; filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 22px rgba(160,200,255,.4));"></canvas>
1001
<!-- Resize handle -->
1002
<div id="disco-resize" style="width:16px;height:16px;cursor:nwse-resize;position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border-radius:0 0 50% 0;pointer-events:auto;"></div>
1003

1004
1005
<script>
1006
(function(){
1007
const C = document.getElementById('discoCanvas');
1008
if(!C) return;
1009
const ctx = C.getContext('2d');
1010
// S, R, cx, cy are derived live from canvas size in drawFrame
1011
1012
// Tile grid: ROWS latitude bands, COLS columns per equator
1013
const ROWS = 14, BASE_COLS = 20;
1014
1015
// Fixed light direction (upper-left-front)
1016
const Lx = -0.5, Ly = -0.7, Lz = 0.8;
1017
const Ll = Math.hypot(Lx,Ly,Lz);
1018
const lx=Lx/Ll, ly=Ly/Ll, lz=Lz/Ll;
1019
1020
let spin = 0; // rotation angle around Y axis
1021
1022
function project(px,py,pz,R,cx,cy) {
1023
const fov = 260;
1024
const z = pz + fov;
1025
return [ cx + px * fov / z * R, cy + py * fov / z * R ];
1026
}
1027
1028
function drawFrame(a) {
1029
const S = C.width, R = S*0.436, cx = S/2, cy = S/2+S*0.036;
1030
ctx.clearRect(0,0,S,S);
1031
1032
// ── Dark base sphere (shows through gaps) ──
1033
ctx.save();
1034
ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.clip();
1035
const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx-R*.3,cy-R*.38,2, cx,cy,R);
1036
bg.addColorStop(0,'#c0d0e8');
1037
bg.addColorStop(.3,'#506070');
1038
bg.addColorStop(.7,'#1e2c3a');
1039
bg.addColorStop(1,'#070d14');
1040
ctx.fillStyle=bg; ctx.fillRect(0,0,S,S);
1041
ctx.restore();
1042
1043
// ── Collect and depth-sort tile faces ──
1044
const faces = [];
1045
for(let row=0; row<ROWS; row++){
1046
const phi0 = Math.PI * row/ROWS;
1047
const phi1 = Math.PI * (row+1)/ROWS;
1048
const phiM = (phi0+phi1)/2;
1049
const cols = Math.max(4, Math.round(BASE_COLS * Math.sin(phiM)));
1050
for(let col=0; col<cols; col++){
1051
const t0 = 2*Math.PI*col/cols + a;
1052
const t1 = 2*Math.PI*(col+1)/cols + a;
1053
const tM = (t0+t1)/2;
1054
1055
// Surface normal at tile centre (unit sphere)
1056
const nx = Math.sin(phiM)*Math.cos(tM);
1057
const ny = -Math.cos(phiM);
1058
const nz = Math.sin(phiM)*Math.sin(tM);
1059
1060
if(nz < 0) continue; // back-face cull
1061
1062
// Depth = Z of tile centre (for painter's sort)
1063
faces.push({ row, col, phi0, phi1, t0, t1, tM, nx, ny, nz, depth: nz });
1064
}
1065
}
1066
1067
// Paint back-to-front
1068
faces.sort((a,b)=>a.depth-b.depth);
1069
1070
for(const f of faces){
1071
// 4 corners of this tile on the unit sphere, scaled to radius R
1072
const corners4 = [
1073
[f.phi0, f.t0],[f.phi0, f.t1],
1074
[f.phi1, f.t1],[f.phi1, f.t0]
1075
].map(([p,t])=>{
1076
const X = Math.sin(p)*Math.cos(t);
1077
const Y = -Math.cos(p);
1078
const Z = Math.sin(p)*Math.sin(t);
1079
return project(X, Y, Z, R, cx, cy);
1080
});
1081
1082
// Lighting
1083
const diff = Math.max(0, f.nx*lx + f.ny*ly + f.nz*lz);
1084
// Specular (viewer along +Z)
1085
const hx=(lx+0)/2, hy=(ly+0)/2, hz=(lz+1)/2;
1086
const hl=Math.hypot(hx,hy,hz);
1087
const spec = Math.pow(Math.max(0,(f.nx*hx/hl + f.ny*hy/hl + f.nz*hz/hl)), 40);
1088
1089
// Base mirror tile color: cool silver-blue
1090
const base = [200, 215, 235];
1091
const br = 0.15 + diff*0.55 + spec*0.85;
1092
const rr = Math.min(255, base[0]*br + spec*255*0.5)|0;
1093
const gg = Math.min(255, base[1]*br + spec*255*0.55)|0;
1094
const bb = Math.min(255, base[2]*br + spec*255*0.7)|0;
1095
1096
ctx.beginPath();
1097
ctx.moveTo(corners4[0][0], corners4[0][1]);
1098
ctx.lineTo(corners4[1][0], corners4[1][1]);
1099
ctx.lineTo(corners4[2][0], corners4[2][1]);
1100
ctx.lineTo(corners4[3][0], corners4[3][1]);
1101
ctx.closePath();
1102
1103
ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${rr},${gg},${bb})`;
1104
ctx.fill();
1105
1106
// Grout gap
1107
ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
1108
ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
1109
ctx.stroke();
1110
}
1111
1112
// ── Limb darkening ring for roundness ──
1113
ctx.save();
1114
ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.clip();
1115
const rim = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,R*0.6, cx,cy,R);
1116
rim.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
1117
rim.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)');
1118
ctx.fillStyle=rim; ctx.fillRect(0,0,S,S);
1119
ctx.restore();
1120
1121
// ── Specular glare spot (fixed position, gives sense of solid sphere) ──
1122
ctx.save();
1123
ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.clip();
1124
const glare = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx-R*.28,cy-R*.32,1, cx-R*.22,cy-R*.25,R*.32);
1125
glare.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.72)');
1126
glare.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(255,255,255,.18)');
1127
glare.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
1128
ctx.fillStyle=glare; ctx.fillRect(0,0,S,S);
1129
ctx.restore();
1130
}
1131
1132
// ── Disco dot reflections — rings of dots spinning around center-stage ──
1133
// Dots are placed in concentric rings on the floor, centered below the ball,
1134
// and rotate in sync with the ball's spin angle.
1135
1136
const DOT_RINGS = [
1137
{ r: 40, count: 8, sz: 3.5 },
1138
{ r: 90, count: 14, sz: 3 },
1139
{ r: 150, count: 20, sz: 3 },
1140
{ r: 210, count: 26, sz: 2.5 },
1141
{ r: 270, count: 32, sz: 2.5 },
1142
{ r: 330, count: 36, sz: 2 },
1143
];
1144
1145
const DOT_TINTS = [
1146
[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],
1147
[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],
1148
[255,200,180],[180,220,255],[180,255,210],[255,255,160],[220,170,255],
1149
[255,210,140],[160,245,255],[255,170,220],[200,255,170],[255,225,140],
1150
];
1151
1152
const dots = [];
1153
let tintIdx = 0;
1154
DOT_RINGS.forEach((ring) => {
1155
for(let i = 0; i < ring.count; i++){
1156
const el = document.createElement('div');
1157
const sz = ring.sz + Math.random()*1;
1158
const tint = DOT_TINTS[tintIdx++ % DOT_TINTS.length];
1159
el.style.cssText = `
1160
position:fixed; border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; z-index:5;
1161
width:${sz}px; height:${sz}px;
1162
background: radial-gradient(circle,
1163
rgba(${tint[0]},${tint[1]},${tint[2]},0.95) 0%,
1164
rgba(${tint[0]},${tint[1]},${tint[2]},0.3) 55%,
1165
transparent 100%);
1166
box-shadow: 0 0 ${sz*1.5}px ${sz*0.7}px rgba(${tint[0]},${tint[1]},${tint[2]},0.45);
1167
will-change: left, top, opacity;
1168
`;
1169
document.body.appendChild(el);
1170
dots.push({
1171
el, sz,
1172
r: ring.r,
1173
baseAngle: (2 * Math.PI * i) / ring.count,
1174
});
1175
}
1176
});
1177
1178
function updateDots(a) {
1179
const vw = window.innerWidth, vh = window.innerHeight;
1180
const STAGE_X = vw / 2;
1181
const STAGE_Y = vh - 110;
1182
1183
for(const d of dots){
1184
// All dots rotate clockwise at the same rate as the ball
1185
const angle = d.baseAngle + a;
1186
const cosA = Math.cos(angle);
1187
const sinA = Math.sin(angle);
1188
1189
// Ellipse on floor: full width horizontally, squished vertically for perspective
1190
const px = STAGE_X + cosA * d.r;
1191
const py = STAGE_Y + sinA * (d.r / 3);
1192
1193
// Smooth opacity — dots behind centre-line (sinA < 0) are slightly dimmer
1194
// but NO hard cutoff — continuous sine wave so no line glitch
1195
const opacity = 0.3 + (sinA * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.65;
1196
1197
d.el.style.opacity = opacity.toFixed(3);
1198
d.el.style.left = (px - d.sz / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px';
1199
d.el.style.top = (py - d.sz / 2).toFixed(1) + 'px';
1200
}
1201
}
1202
1203
// ── Mirror glints — each tile on the ball reflects the light source as a sharp
1204
// dot that RACES across the scene. When that ray sweeps through the viewer's
1205
// eye position it creates a direct retinal flash. ──
1206
1207
// Single fixed light source (upper-left, like a stage par can)
1208
const LX = -0.55, LY = -0.65, LZ = 0.52;
1209
const LL = Math.hypot(LX,LY,LZ);
1210
const lx2=LX/LL, ly2=LY/LL, lz2=LZ/LL;
1211
1212
// Build one canvas that covers the whole viewport for the sweeping dots
1213
const glintCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
1214
glintCanvas.style.cssText = `
1215
position:fixed; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%;
1216
pointer-events:none; z-index:5;
1217
`;
1218
document.body.appendChild(glintCanvas);
1219
const gctx = glintCanvas.getContext('2d');
1220
1221
// Viewer eye position (normalised — straight ahead = 0,0,1)
1222
// We treat the viewer as looking along +Z from screen center
1223
const EYE_X = 0, EYE_Y = 0, EYE_Z = 1;
1224
1225
// Tile grid — use same rows/cols as the drawn ball
1226
const G_ROWS = 14, G_BASE = 20;
1227
const tiles2 = [];
1228
for(let row=0; row<G_ROWS; row++){
1229
const phi = Math.PI*(row+0.5)/G_ROWS;
1230
const cols = Math.max(4, Math.round(G_BASE*Math.sin(phi)));
1231
for(let col=0; col<cols; col++){
1232
tiles2.push({ phi, tOff: (2*Math.PI*col/cols) });
1233
}
1234
}
1235

1237

1238

1239

1245

1252
} catch(e){}

function getBallCenter(){
1256
const canvas = document.getElementById("discoCanvas");
1257
const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
1258
return { x: r.left+r.width/2, y: r.top+r.height/2 };
1259

1261
function updateFlashes(a) {
1262
const vw = glintCanvas.width, vh = glintCanvas.height;
1263
const bc = getBallCenter();
1264
const BX = bc.x, BY = bc.y;
1265
1266
gctx.clearRect(0,0,vw,vh);
1267
1268
for(const t of tiles2){
1269
const theta = t.tOff + a;
1270
1271
// Tile surface normal (Y-axis spin)
1272
const nx = Math.sin(t.phi)*Math.cos(theta);
1273
const ny = -Math.cos(t.phi);
1274
const nz = Math.sin(t.phi)*Math.sin(theta);
1275
1276
// ── 1. Reflected light-source ray off this tile ──
1277
// Incident = direction FROM light TO tile = (lx2,ly2,lz2)
1278
// R = I - 2(I·N)N
1279
const iDotN = lx2*nx + ly2*ny + lz2*nz;
1280
const rx = lx2 - 2*iDotN*nx;
1281
const ry = ly2 - 2*iDotN*ny;
1282
const rz = lz2 - 2*iDotN*nz;
1283
1284
// ── 2. How close does this reflected ray pass to the viewer's eye? ──
1285
// Viewer eye = along +Z axis from screen center.
1286
// "Facing the viewer" = rz < 0 (ray coming toward screen) AND
1287
// the ray direction is close to (0,0,-1).
1288
// Dot of reflected ray with (0,0,-1) = -rz
1289
const toViewer = -rz; // 1 = ray aimed straight at viewer
1290
if(toViewer < 0.01) continue; // ray going away from viewer
1291
1292
// Angular proximity to viewer's eye — sharp Gaussian spike
1293
// eyeProx peaks at 1 when ray points exactly at (0,0,-1)
1294
const eyeProx = Math.pow(Math.max(0, toViewer), 12);
1295
1296
// Tile must face somewhat toward light to be "lit"
1297
const litFace = Math.max(0, lx2*nx + ly2*ny + lz2*nz);
1298
if(litFace < 0.05) continue;
1299
1300
// ── Eye flash — when reflected ray aims at viewer, blast from draggable position ──
1301
if(eyeProx > 0.001){
1302
const _fp = window._flashPos || {x: vw/2, y: vh*0.45};
1303
const fx = _fp.x + nx * vw * 0.18;
1304
const fy = _fp.y;
1305
const fSize = 30 + eyeProx * 340;
1306
const fAlpha = eyeProx * 0.88;
1307
1308
const fg = gctx.createRadialGradient(fx,fy,0, fx,fy,fSize);
1309
fg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,255,255,${fAlpha})`);
1310
fg.addColorStop(0.08, `rgba(255,255,255,${fAlpha*0.9})`);
1311
fg.addColorStop(0.25, `rgba(255,255,230,${fAlpha*0.5})`);
1312
fg.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(255,255,200,${fAlpha*0.15})`);
1313
fg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
1314
gctx.beginPath();
1315
gctx.arc(fx, fy, fSize, 0, Math.PI*2);
1316
gctx.fillStyle = fg;
1317
gctx.fill();
1318
1319
// Extra hard white core
1320
if(eyeProx > 0.3){
1321
const cg = gctx.createRadialGradient(fx,fy,0, fx,fy,eyeProx*18);
1322
cg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,255,255,${eyeProx})`);
1323
cg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
1324
gctx.beginPath();
1325
gctx.arc(fx,fy,eyeProx*18,0,Math.PI*2);
1326
gctx.fillStyle = cg;
1327
gctx.fill();
1328
}
1329
}
1330
}
1331
}

// ── Light beams canvas — multi-layer rays from ball surface in all directions ──
1334

1335
beamCanvas.style.cssText = `
1336
position:fixed; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%;
1337
pointer-events:none; z-index:5;
1338
`;
1339
document.body.appendChild(beamCanvas);

1341
1342
function resizeBeam(){
1343
beamCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
1344
beamCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
1345

resizeBeam();
1347
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeBeam);
1348
1349
const BEAM_COLORS = [
1350
[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],[255,255,255],
1351
[255,200,200],[200,210,255],[200,255,220],[255,255,180],[230,190,255],
1352
[255,220,160],[180,250,255],[255,190,230],[210,255,190],[255,235,160],
1353
];
1354
1355
// Build rays across multiple latitude bands — like real mirror tiles on a sphere
1356
// Each layer has a different elevation angle, rays spread around full 360°
1357
const LAYERS = [
1358
{ elevation: -0.9, count: 6, len: 1800, width: 0.8 }, // near straight down
1359
{ elevation: -0.65, count: 10, len: 1800, width: 0.7 },
1360
{ elevation: -0.4, count: 14, len: 1800, width: 0.6 },
1361
{ elevation: -0.15, count: 18, len: 1800, width: 0.5 }, // horizontal-ish
1362
{ elevation: 0.15, count: 18, len: 1800, width: 0.5 },
1363
{ elevation: 0.4, count: 14, len: 1800, width: 0.6 },
1364
{ elevation: 0.65, count: 10, len: 1800, width: 0.7 },
1365
{ elevation: 0.9, count: 6, len: 1800, width: 0.8 }, // near straight up
1366
];
1367
1368
const rays = [];
1369
let colorIdx = 0;
1370
LAYERS.forEach((layer, li) => {
1371
for(let i = 0; i < layer.count; i++){
1372
rays.push({
1373
azimuth: (2 * Math.PI * i / layer.count) + (li * 0.3), // offset each layer
1374
elevation: layer.elevation,
1375
len: layer.len,
1376
width: layer.width,
1377
color: BEAM_COLORS[colorIdx++ % BEAM_COLORS.length],
1378
});
1379
}
1380
});
1381
1382
function updateBeams(a) {
1383
const vw = beamCanvas.width, vh = beamCanvas.height;
1384
const bc = getBallCenter();
1385
const ballX = bc.x, ballY = bc.y;
1386
const ballR = document.getElementById('discoCanvas').getBoundingClientRect().width / 2;
1387
1388
bctx.clearRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
1389
1390
for(const ray of rays){
1391
// Spin azimuth with ball rotation
1392
const az = ray.azimuth + a;
1393
const el = ray.elevation;
1394
1395
// 3D direction of this ray
1396
const cosEl = Math.cos(Math.asin(el));
1397
const dx3 = cosEl * Math.cos(az);
1398
const dy3 = cosEl * Math.sin(az);
1399
const dz3 = el; // vertical component
1400
1401
// Project onto 2D screen: x = dx3, y = dz3 (vertical on screen), z = dy3 (depth)
1402
const screenDX = dx3;
1403
const screenDY = dz3; // elevation maps to vertical on screen
1404
1405
const len2D = Math.hypot(screenDX, screenDY);
1406
const ux = len2D > 0.001 ? screenDX / len2D : 1;
1407
const uy = len2D > 0.001 ? screenDY / len2D : 0;
1408
1409
// Origin: ball surface
1410
const originX = ballX + ux * ballR;
1411
const originY = ballY + uy * ballR;
1412
1413
// End point: extend far in screen direction
1414
const endX = originX + ux * ray.len;
1415
const endY = originY + uy * ray.len;
1416
1417
// Perpendicular for beam width
1418
const px = -uy, py = ux;
1419
1420
// Depth cue — beams going "into" screen (dy3 > 0) are slightly dimmer
1421
const depthOpacity = 0.06 + (1 - Math.abs(dy3) * 0.5) * 0.12;
1422
const spreadEnd = ray.width * 12;
1423
1424
const p = new Path2D();
1425
p.moveTo(originX + px * ray.width, originY + py * ray.width);
1426
p.lineTo(originX - px * ray.width, originY - py * ray.width);
1427
p.lineTo(endX - px * spreadEnd, endY - py * spreadEnd);
1428
p.lineTo(endX + px * spreadEnd, endY + py * spreadEnd);
1429
p.closePath();
1430
1431
const [r,g,bl] = ray.color;
1432
const grad = bctx.createLinearGradient(originX, originY, endX, endY);
1433
grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r},${g},${bl},0)`);
1434
grad.addColorStop(0.05, `rgba(${r},${g},${bl},${(depthOpacity).toFixed(3)})`);
1435
grad.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(${r},${g},${bl},${(depthOpacity*0.6).toFixed(3)})`);
1436
grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r},${g},${bl},0)`);
1437
1438
bctx.save();
1439
bctx.fillStyle = grad;
1440
bctx.fill(p);
1441
bctx.restore();
1442
}
1443
}
1444

1447

1458
flashEl.style.transform = 'none';
1459
window._flashPos = { x: bc.x, y: bc.y };
1460
}
1461
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
1462
}
1463
loop();
1464
})();

<script>
1837

1838

1839

1841

1854
];

const ul = document.getElementById('songList');
1857
songs.forEach((s,i) => {
1858
const li = document.createElement('li');
1859
li.className='song-item';
1860
const listenBtn = s.video
1861
? `<button onclick="openVideo()" class="btn btn-video">🎬 VIDEO</button>`
1862
: `<button onclick="playSong(${i})" class="btn btn-listen" id="btn-${i}">▶ Listen</button>`;
1863
li.innerHTML=`

<div class="track-num">${i+1}</div>

<div class="song-info">

${listenBtn}

1879

function playSong(i) {
1881
const audio = document.getElementById('audio-'+i);
1882
const btn = document.getElementById('btn-'+i);
1883
if (currentAudio && currentAudio !== audio) {
1884
currentAudio.pause();
1885
currentAudio.currentTime = 0;
1886
if (currentBtn) currentBtn.textContent = '▶ Listen';
1887
}
1888
if (audio.paused) {
1889
audio.play();
1890
btn.textContent = '⏸ Pause';
1891
currentAudio = audio;
1892
currentBtn = btn;
1893
audio.onended = () => { btn.textContent = '▶ Listen'; currentAudio = null; currentBtn = null; };
1894
} else {
1895
audio.pause();
1896
btn.textContent = '▶ Listen';
1897
currentAudio = null;
1898
currentBtn = null;
1899
}
1900
